notes.title: v 1.0.6 Crash fix in Chapter 4
notes.notes: We’ve finally managed to resolve the crash in Chapter 4 that some players experienced after the cutscene with the character walking past the TVs (huge thanks to player iik0n).

notes.title: v 1.0.5 Crash Fix
notes.notes: -Implemented a fix aimed at resolving a rare crash occurring after the cutscene ends (upon exiting the train car with the 3 buttons and TVs) in Chapter 4.

notes.title: v 1.0.4 Minor changes and improvements
notes.notes:
-Minor changes and improvements.
-Improved navigation and object interaction in Chapter 4 to reduce player frustration.

notes.title: Fix for crashes and addition of save indicators
notes.notes:
-Fixed rare crashes in Chapter 4.
-Added save icons at the beginning of each chapter to make it easier to track progress.

notes.title: "THE DERAILED" DEMO WILL BE AVAILABLE ON FEBRUARY 21
notes.notes:
Darkness is closing in. Very soon, it will throw open its doors, and you will take your first step into the unknown.

On February 21, the demo of "The Derailed" will be available.

Do you dare to dive into a world where answers are hidden behind a veil of madness, and the only way out is to keep moving forward — even when everything inside you screams to stop?
